map.休闲挑战：移动底部挡板反弹小球，击碎上方所有砖块即过关。: Casual challenge: move the bottom paddle to bounce the ball and break all the bricks above to clear the level.
map.怎么让球路更可控？: How do I make the ball path more controllable?
map.手眼协调：用挡板角度控制球路，避免球落底失球。: Hand-eye coordination: control the ball path with the paddle angle so the ball does not fall to the bottom and cost a life.
map.挡板左右移动接球，球碰砖块即消并反弹；球落到底部（漏接）扣一条命；清空全部砖块过: Move the paddle left and right to bounce the ball; a ball that hits a brick destroys it and rebounds; letting the ball fall to the bottom costs a life; clear all bricks to pass. The score = bricks broken x points per brick, and keeping a streak without a miss preserves the ball speed and rhythm. ...
map.球速越来越快怎么办？: What if the ball keeps getting faster?
map.用挡板「边缘」而非中心接球可改变出射角；想打高处就偏接让球斜上，想保命就中心稳接: Catching the ball with the edge of the paddle rather than the centre changes the launch angle; to hit high, catch off-centre so the ball goes up diagonally, and to stay alive catch it solidly in the centre.
map.策略演示：优先打掉边缘砖块制造多段反弹，提高清屏效率。: Strategy demo: clear the edge bricks first to create multi-bounce rebounds and raise the clearing efficiency.
map.这是难度递增设计；保持球在底部中线附近、提前移动挡板接，比追着球跑更稳。: This is a rising-difficulty design; keeping the ball near the bottom centre and moving the paddle early to meet it is steadier than chasing the ball.
